task_description: Create a complete AI Tajweed Teacher Android app (AI Tajweed Ustoz) with Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, OpenAI Whisper API integration, Firebase backend, and Room DB for offline storage. The app teaches Tajweed rules with lessons, voice recording/analysis, real-time feedback, practice mode, and progress tracking.

verification.summary: Build/test verification skipped due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode (no Android SDK). All 73 Kotlin files, 18 XML resource files, and 5 Gradle config files verified for structural correctness. Semantic review (v2) approved with 4 non-blocking suggestions for future improvement.

review_notes: v2 review APPROVED. 4 non-blocking items noted for future: (1) UserProgress upsert by ruleId, (2) SharedPreference listener lifecycle, (3) DI consolidation of EncryptedSharedPreferences, (4) dead variable cleanup.
